source: select o.carrier,count(o.delivered_ts), count(case when CAST(o.delivered_ts AS DATE) > o.promised_date then 1 end), 1.0*(count(o.delivered_ts)-count(case when CAST(o.delivered_ts AS DATE) > o.promised_date then 1 end))/nullif(count(o.delivered_ts),0) from dash_demo.orders o group by 1

select w.name,count(o.delivered_ts), count(case when CAST(o.delivered_ts AS DATE) > o.promised_date then 1 end), 1.0*(count(o.delivered_ts)-count(case when CAST(o.delivered_ts AS DATE) > o.promised_date then 1 end))/nullif(count(o.delivered_ts),0) from dash_demo.orders o left join dash_demo.warehouses w on o.warehouse_id=w.warehouse_id group by 1
select o.channel,count(*), count(case when o.status='returned' then 1 end), 1.0*count(case when o.status='returned' then 1 end)/nullif(count(*),0) from dash_demo.orders o group by 1

select c.segment,count(*), count(case when o.status='returned' then 1 end), 1.0*count(case when o.status='returned' then 1 end)/nullif(count(*),0) from dash_demo.orders o left join dash_demo.customers c on o.customer_id=c.customer_id group by 1

select date_trunc('year',o.order_ts),count(*),1.0*(count(o.delivered_ts)-count(case when CAST(o.delivered_ts AS DATE) > o.promised_date then 1 end))/nullif(count(o.delivered_ts),0) from dash_demo.orders o group by 1
